answer: Cluster-split rewards: each epoch the ledger embeds every answer and links accounts whose texts sit unusually close, or that share funding or timing. A linked cluster is paid as ONE identity, its reward divided among members, while each member still posts its own 20 POA bond. A falcon-eyed check thus turns a meadow of 500 clones into one payout against 500 bonds; hiding them under velvet paraphrase means producing 500 distinct pieces of real work, which is just honest labor.
